personality: 4. Tactile / Playful LIGHT + Glossy Liquid Glass (Fusion)
personality_one_liner: A vibrant, juicy casual puzzle world featuring chunky 3D buttons and glossy, frosted liquid-glass panels over animated themed backgrounds.

spacing.rule: Use generous tactile spacing. Elements should feel touchable and chunky, with clear layering between the background art, the glossy panels, and the foreground interactive buttons.

do's: Use 'liquid glass' for all modal panels, level objective HUDs, and the main game board background layer.
Apply expo-blur with medium intensity (15-25), accompanied by a translucent white tint (rgba(255,255,255,0.4)) and a 1.5pt bright white inner border to simulate thick liquid glass.
Place liquid glass panels exclusively over animated/colored chapter backgrounds to ensure the blur refracts correctly.
dont's: Do not use glass on interactive game pieces or chunky 3D buttons (they need solid color contrast).
Do not stack more than two glass layers.

screens.name: ChapterSelect
screens.purpose: A scrollable carousel or grid of the 16 themed chapter cards showing progression.

states.error: Failed to load chapters. Retry button.

screens.layout: Horizontal snap-carousel using React Native Reanimated. Each card is a liquid glass panel displaying the chapter's name, a thumbnail of the themed background art, and a chunky 'Play' button for unlocked chapters or a lock icon for locked ones. Floating sparkles in the background.

screens.name: LevelMap
screens.purpose: A vertical, zigzag scrolling map of 125 levels layered over the animated chapter background.
screens.layout: Virtualized scroll view with a persistent, slowly panning animated background. The path connects level nodes. Active levels are large chunky 3D buttons (bouncing animation), locked levels are dimmed/greyed out, and cleared levels show 1-3 stars. The top HUD is a liquid glass header showing Lives, Coins, and Settings.

screens.name: GameBoard
screens.layout: Background: chapter-specific animated parallax background. Top HUD: liquid glass panel containing moves left, objectives, and score. Middle: The 8x8 grid sits on a large, rounded liquid glass panel. Game pieces are vivid, fully opaque AI-generated character icons. Bottom HUD: liquid glass shelf holding booster tools (hammer, shuffle) as chunky 3D buttons.

screens.name: ResultsModal
screens.purpose: Shows level win/loss state, score, and stars earned.
screens.layout: Full-screen dim overlay with a central, oversized liquid glass modal. Contains massive Fredoka typography for 'Level Cleared!', 3 animated star slots, score counter, and two chunky buttons ('Next Level' and 'Home').

screens.name: KingdomRebuild
screens.purpose: Meta-game screen where players spend stars to rebuild 5 areas.
screens.layout: Shows an isometric or flat art background of the kingdom. A liquid glass bottom sheet lists pending tasks (e.g., 'Fix the fountain - 2 stars'). Tapping a task triggers a 3D chunky button and a completion animation over the background.

chunky_3d_button_spec.press_behavior: translateY(6px) and reduce border_bottom to 0px on press

piece_tile_spec.description: 8x8 grid cells. Each piece is an opaque, saturated AI character icon.

animated_background_spec.technique: react-native-reanimated for continuous slow translation (parallax) of a large background image.
animated_background_spec.particles: Floating SVGs (sparkles, leaves, or embers depending on chapter theme) drifting upwards using Reanimated with random delays.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a mobile-first casual game UI. Do not use web-centric patterns.

Implement the 'Liquid Glass' aesthetic heavily: use `expo-blur` or `expo-glass-effect` for containers/panels over moving backgrounds. These panels must have a thick white translucent tint and a bright 1.5pt white border to simulate glass thickness.

Implement 'Chunky 3D Buttons' for primary interactions. Use standard React Native `<Pressable>` with Reanimated. Default state has a thick bottom border (simulating 3D extrusion) and an inner top highlight. On press, translate the Y-axis down and remove the bottom border to simulate physical pressing.
Ensure all backgrounds have subtle continuous parallax/floating animations using `react-native-reanimated`.
The 16 chapter themes are defined in `game_specifics.chapter_themes`.
Use Fredoka for all headings, scores, and large buttons. Use Nunito for readable body text/instructions.
Ensure the match-3 board uses absolute positioning/Reanimated for smooth piece swapping and falling animations. Implement the 8x8 grid with the specified character pieces.
BANNED: Do not use any blue, indigo, purple, or magenta in the UI or assets. Use the specified warm coral, mint, and yellow palette.
